verdict.rationale: Feitian documents W3C WebAuthn compatibility and U2F registration/authentication, plus first-party guides for Google Advanced Protection, Microsoft applications, Azure AD/Office 365, and registering with online accounts in general. GitHub is covered only for OpenSSH connections rather than web 2FA, and password managers are never mentioned. missing for 10: GitHub web-login WebAuthn guidance, any password-manager (e.g. vault 2FA) compatibility evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration across services.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works as a WebAuthn/U2F second factor across the major services I already use — Google, GitHub, Microsoft, password managers
